purpose: Compare Shapley coalition-credit estimators under matched new unique value-oracle cost while separating aggregate estimation from rare-positive-safe elimination and explicitly pricing exact completion.

game.definition: v(S)=1 iff S contains at least one minimal_support; otherwise 0

estimators.description: iid random permutations; evaluate missing coalition vertices through a global cache; estimate Shapley from observed permutation marginals
random permutation plus reverse; global coalition cache; estimate from observed permutation marginals

sample coalition vertices uniformly without replacement; use Horvitz-Thompson weighting for marginal edges whose two endpoints were sampled; point estimator only unless a valid dependent-edge bound is supplied

for each player i and coalition size k, sample S uniformly without replacement from {S subset N\{i}: |S|=k}; observe delta_i(S)=v(S union {i})-v(S); aggregate equally across k because phi_i=(1/n) sum_k mean_k delta_i
estimators.uncertainty: pre-specified-checkpoint finite-population one-sided bounds per player/size stratum, combined by union bound; time-uniform WoR confidence sequences may replace checkpoint bounds only if implemented from a cited valid construction without outcome-dependent tuning

estimators.description: separate sequential action that evaluates every remaining coalition value and computes exact Shapley; its remaining oracle calls are charged explicitly

confidence.checkpointing_rule: Any fixed-time bound used for optional stopping across the listed checkpoints must receive explicit alpha allocation across checkpoints, players and size strata before outcomes. A time-uniform WoR confidence sequence may instead use its own simultaneous guarantee.
source_family: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas, Confidence Sequences for Sampling Without Replacement, NeurIPS 2020
Bardenet and Maillard, Concentration inequalities for sampling without replacement, Bernoulli 2015

safe_elimination.certification_rule: At threshold epsilon, certify phi_i <= epsilon only when a valid one-sided upper bound is <= epsilon, or by exact completion.
safe_elimination.false_elimination: exact_phi_i > epsilon but method certifies phi_i <= epsilon
safe_elimination.strict_zero_note: Without additional structural assumptions, incomplete sampling generally cannot certify exact phi_i=0 when unobserved positive marginals remain possible; exact-zero demotion therefore defaults to exact completion. Statistical stopping is primarily for epsilon-negligibility, not exact logical zero.

comparison_rules.same_seed_set: 0..999 unless runtime/tool limits force a smaller preregistered pilot before any outcome is inspected
comparison_rules.unsupported_uncertainty: If vertex_srswor_ht_edges lacks a defensible bound, report point-estimation metrics only and do not allow it to certify elimination.
comparison_rules.exact_truth: Exact Shapley and false-elimination labels are computed only from the full 1024-coalition game after this protocol is durable.

next_action: Implement the game and estimators exactly as frozen, first validate deterministic exact-enumeration identities, then run the fixed budget grid without changing supports, thresholds, estimator definitions or cost accounting after observing outcomes.
